# Example Docs

Example Docs is a small static site describing its own build. Three markdown files
in one Astro content collection are rendered by one layout and written to disk by
one command. Nothing on the site is produced at request time.

## Pages

- [Content collections reference](https://example.com/) - what the collection holds and which route reads it.
- [Routing in content collections](https://example.com/docs/routing) - how an entry id becomes an output path.
- [Deploying a static build](https://example.com/docs/deploying) - what the build writes and what a host has to serve.
- [About this documentation set](https://example.com/about) - who publishes the site and what it leaves out.

## Not covered

The site has no catalogue, no reader accounts, no contributed content and one
language. Pages that would describe those things do not exist, so nothing here
links to them.
